title: Development of bixbyite microdice fabricated cathode for aqueous rechargeable zinc ion batteries
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,15318-15336
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00543D, Paper
Open Access

Nusrat Tazeen Tonu, Mohammad Abu Yousuf, Parbhej Ahamed, Md. Mahfujul Hasan
In this study, an ultrasonic-aided reverse micelle formation, followed by the calcination route, was developed for the synthesis of bixbyite microdice aimed at the fabrication of a cathode for ARZIBs.
